---
title: "Body Performance Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

## Import

```{r}
body <- read.csv("bodyPerformance.csv")
names(body) <- c("age","gender","height","weight","fat","diastolic","systolic",
                 "grip","bend","situps","jump","class")
head(body)
dim(body)
str(body)
sum(is.na(body))
```

```{r}
body$gender <- as.factor(body$gender)
body$class <- as.factor(body$class)
attach(body)
```

## Categorical variables

```{r}
table(gender)
prop.table(table(gender))
barplot(table(gender), col=c('plum2','slateblue'), main='Gender')
```

```{r}
table(class)
pie(table(class), main='Class')
table(gender, class)
```

## Quantitative variables

```{r}
summary(body)
```

```{r}
mean(height)
sd(height)
median(height)
hist(height, main='Height')
boxplot(height, main='Height')
```

```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
hist(weight); hist(fat); hist(grip); hist(jump)
```

## Strange values

```{r}
sum(systolic==0)
sum(diastolic==0)
sum(jump==0)
max(bend)
boxplot(systolic, main='Systolic')
```

## Males vs females

```{r}
boxplot(height~gender, col=c('plum2','slateblue'), main='Height by gender')
boxplot(grip~gender, col=c('plum2','slateblue'), main='Grip by gender')
summary(grip[gender=='F'])
summary(grip[gender=='M'])
```

## Class

```{r}
boxplot(situps~class, main='Sit-ups by class')
boxplot(fat~class, main='Body fat by class')
```

## Relationships

```{r}
plot(height, weight, main='Height vs weight')
cor(height, weight)
plot(age, situps, main='Age vs sit-ups')
cor(age, situps)
```

```{r}
round(cor(body[,-c(2,12)]), 2)
```

```{r}
detach(body)
```
